title.en: Late postpartum preeclampsia with severe features presenting after discharge
title.zh: 出院后出现的迟发性产后子痫前期伴重度特征

summary.en: A 29-year-old primipara calls on postpartum day 4 with a severe headache, visual spots, new facial edema, and repeated home BP of 162/108 after an uncomplicated term vaginal birth and normotensive prenatal course.
summary.zh: 一名 29 岁初产妇在产后第 4 天来电，主诉严重头痛、眼前有斑点、新出现面部水肿，家庭血压反复为 162/108。她此前足月顺产且孕期血压正常。

content.en: G1P1, delivered a healthy 3,400-g infant vaginally at 39 weeks 2 days. Prenatal BP values were below 130/80, urine protein screens were negative, and there is no history of chronic hypertension, renal disease, autoimmune disease, or gestational hypertension. Discharged postpartum day 1 with BP 118/74, expected lochia rubra, firm fundus, no edema, and instructions to call for headache, vision changes, or BP above 140/90 on the home cuff. Breastfeeding. Medications: prenatal vitamins, ibuprofen 600 mg every 6 hours as needed, docusate sodium.
content.zh: G1P1，孕 39 周 2 天经阴道分娩一名健康 3,400 g 婴儿。孕期 BP 均低于 130/80，尿蛋白筛查阴性，无慢性高血压、肾病、自身免疫病或妊娠期高血压史。产后第 1 天出院，BP 118/74，恶露红色量符合预期，宫底坚硬，无水肿；被告知如出现头痛、视力改变或家庭血压超过 140/90 应来电。正在哺乳。用药：产前维生素、布洛芬 600 mg 每 6 小时按需、十二烷基磺基琥珀酸钠。

title.zh: 分娩住院基线实验室结果

content.en: Hemoglobin 11.8 g/dL; hematocrit 35%; platelets 238 ×10³/µL; AST 22 U/L; ALT 18 U/L; creatinine 0.7 mg/dL; uric acid 4.1 mg/dL; LDH 162 U/L; urinalysis negative for protein.
content.zh: 血红蛋白 11.8 g/dL；血细胞比容 35%；血小板 238 ×10³/µL；AST 22 U/L；ALT 18 U/L；肌酐 0.7 mg/dL；尿酸 4.1 mg/dL；LDH 162 U/L；尿检蛋白阴性。

title.en: Stage 1 - Triage call and ED arrival
title.zh: 第 1 阶段——分诊电话和到达急诊

content.en: At 10:15 AM, the patient reports severe frontal headache 8/10 unrelieved by ibuprofen, intermittent visual spots, new facial/periorbital puffiness, and home BP 162/108 twice, five minutes apart. She denies chest pain, shortness of breath, epigastric/RUQ pain, nausea, vomiting, seizure activity, focal weakness, and confusion. Lochia is light serosa and she is voiding without difficulty.
content.zh: 10:15 AM，患者报告严重额部头痛 8/10，布洛芬后未缓解；间歇性眼前有斑点；新出现面部/眼周浮肿；家庭 BP 两次均为 162/108，间隔 5 分钟。她否认胸痛、气短、上腹/右上腹痛、恶心、呕吐、癫痫发作、局灶无力和意识混乱。恶露为少量浆液性，排尿无困难。

content.en: Vitals: T 37.1 C, HR 96, BP 168/112, RR 18, SpO2 99% on room air. Repeat BP five minutes later: 164/110. Headache 9/10 with photophobia. Alert and oriented x4. Pupils equal and reactive; cranial nerves grossly intact; grip strength equal. DTRs 3+ at biceps and patella bilaterally with two beats of ankle clonus. Lungs clear; heart regular. Fundus firm just above symphysis pubis. Lower extremities 1+ pitting edema. Clean-catch urine dipstick: 3+ protein. 18-gauge IV placed and Foley inserted with 150 mL clear yellow urine initially. Stat CBC, CMP, LDH, uric acid, coagulation studies, and urine protein-to-creatinine ratio sent.
content.zh: 生命体征：T 37.1 C，HR 96，BP 168/112，RR 18，室内空气 SpO2 99%。5 分钟后复测 BP 164/110。头痛 9/10，畏光。清醒，定向力正常。瞳孔等大等圆且对光反应存在；颅神经大致完整；握力对称。双侧肱二头肌和髌腱反射 3+，踝阵挛 2 次。肺清，心律规则。宫底坚硬，位于耻骨联合上方。双下肢 1+ 凹陷性水肿。清洁中段尿试纸：蛋白 3+。已置入 18G IV，并插入 Foley，初始尿量 150 mL，清亮黄色。已送急查 CBC、CMP、LDH、尿酸、凝血检查和尿蛋白/肌酐比值。

title.zh: 第 2 阶段——启动急性治疗

content.en: Orders: magnesium sulfate 4 g IV loading dose over 20 minutes, then 2 g/hr continuous infusion for seizure prophylaxis; immediate-release nifedipine 10 mg PO now for acute BP reduction; repeat BP every 5 minutes for 20 minutes, then every 15 minutes; seizure precautions with padded side rails, suction at bedside, dimmed lighting, and minimized stimulation. Magnesium starts by pump at 11:40 AM; nifedipine 10 mg PO is given at 11:45 AM. BP after nifedipine: 158/104 at 11:50, 152/98 at 11:55, 148/96 at noon, 146/94 at 12:15. Urine output first hour: 60 mL. Headache improves to 6/10; occasional spots persist; DTRs remain 3+ with clonus.
content.zh: 医嘱：硫酸镁 4 g IV 负荷剂量 20 分钟内输注，随后 2 g/hr 连续输注用于癫痫预防；速释硝苯地平 10 mg PO 立即用于急性降压；前 20 分钟每 5 分钟复测 BP，之后每 15 分钟；癫痫预防措施包括床栏加垫、床旁备吸引、调暗灯光和减少刺激。11:40 AM 用输液泵开始硫酸镁；11:45 AM 给予硝苯地平 10 mg PO。硝苯地平后 BP：11:50 为 158/104，11:55 为 152/98，12:00 为 148/96，12:15 为 146/94。第一小时尿量 60 mL。头痛改善至 6/10；偶有视觉斑点；深腱反射仍为 3+ 并有阵挛。

content.en: Hemoglobin 12.0 g/dL; hematocrit 36%; platelets 195 ×10³/µL; AST 34 U/L; ALT 28 U/L; creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; uric acid 6.8 mg/dL; LDH 198 U/L; INR 1.0; fibrinogen 380 mg/dL; urine protein-to-creatinine ratio 0.42.
content.zh: 血红蛋白 12.0 g/dL；血细胞比容 36%；血小板 195 ×10³/µL；AST 34 U/L；ALT 28 U/L；肌酐 0.9 mg/dL；尿酸 6.8 mg/dL；LDH 198 U/L；INR 1.0；纤维蛋白原 380 mg/dL；尿蛋白/肌酐比值 0.42。

content.en: The patient asks whether she can continue breastfeeding while receiving nifedipine and magnesium. She can usually continue breastfeeding while receiving these medications, but lactation support may be needed because illness, hospitalization, and magnesium therapy can delay lactation or make feeding more difficult.
content.zh: 患者询问接受硝苯地平和硫酸镁时是否可以继续哺乳。通常可在接受这些药物时继续哺乳，但可能需要哺乳支持，因为疾病、住院和硫酸镁治疗可能延迟泌乳或增加喂养困难。

title.zh: 第 3 阶段——复评和稳定

content.en: At 1:00 PM BP is 142/90. At 1:30 PM BP is 138/88; headache is 4/10; visual spots have resolved; facial edema is unchanged; DTRs are 2+ with no clonus; RR 16/min; patient is alert. Urine output second hour is 45 mL. Magnesium continues at 2 g/hr. Later BP: 140/86 at 2:00 PM and 136/84 at 2:30 PM. Provider plan: continue magnesium for 24 hours from the loading dose, start nifedipine ER 30 mg every 12 hours for maintenance BP control, and repeat HELLP panel in 6 hours.
content.zh: 1:00 PM BP 142/90。1:30 PM BP 138/88；头痛 4/10；视觉斑点消失；面部水肿无变化；深腱反射 2+，无阵挛；RR 16 次/分；患者清醒。第二小时尿量 45 mL。硫酸镁继续以 2 g/hr 输注。随后 BP：2:00 PM 为 140/86，2:30 PM 为 136/84。医嘱计划：从负荷剂量开始继续硫酸镁 24 小时，开始硝苯地平 ER 30 mg 每 12 小时用于维持血压控制，并 6 小时后复查 HELLP 相关检查。

content.en: The patient asks when she can go home and whether this can happen again. Her mother feels guilty for telling her the symptoms were normal and asks what warning signs she should watch for after discharge.
content.zh: 患者询问什么时候可以回家，以及这种情况是否会再次发生。她的母亲因曾告诉她这些症状正常而感到内疚，并询问出院后应观察哪些警示征象。

stem.en: During the postpartum triage call, highlight the findings that form the urgent preeclampsia-with-severe-features cluster requiring immediate emergency evaluation.
stem.zh: 在产后分诊电话中，请高亮显示构成子痫前期伴重度特征、需要立即急诊评估的紧急发现组合。

segments.en: Severe frontal headache rated 8/10 unrelieved by ibuprofen.
segments.zh: 严重额部头痛，8/10，服用布洛芬后未缓解。

segments.en: Intermittent scotomata described as seeing spots.
segments.zh: 间歇性暗点，描述为“看到斑点”。

segments.en: New facial and periorbital edema that is markedly different from yesterday.
segments.zh: 新出现的面部和眼周水肿，与前一天明显不同。

segments.en: Home BP is 162/108 on two readings five minutes apart.
segments.zh: 家庭血压两次测量均为 162/108，两次间隔 5 分钟。

segments.en: Lochia has transitioned to light serosa.
segments.zh: 恶露已转为少量浆液性恶露。

segments.en: Voiding without difficulty with estimated adequate urine output.
segments.zh: 排尿无困难，估计尿量充足。

segments.en: Denies chest pain and shortness of breath.
segments.zh: 否认胸痛和气短。

segments.en: Reports poor sleep related to newborn care.
segments.zh: 因照顾新生儿而睡眠不足。

correct.en: The severe headache unrelieved by analgesic, visual scotomata, new facial/periorbital edema, and repeated BP of 162/108 on postpartum day 4 are an urgent severe-feature cluster. Expected lochia, adequate voiding, no chest pain, and poor sleep do not make the cluster less urgent.
correct.zh: 未被止痛药缓解的严重头痛、视觉暗点、新出现的面部/眼周水肿，以及产后第 4 天反复测得 BP 162/108，构成重度特征的紧急组合。恶露符合预期、排尿充足、无胸痛和睡眠不足，不能降低这一组合的紧急性。

byChoice.en: A severe headache that does not respond to ibuprofen is a central nervous system warning sign in this context.
byChoice.zh: 布洛芬不能缓解的严重头痛，在此情境下是中枢神经系统警示征象。

byChoice.en: Scotomata are visual symptoms that increase concern for severe preeclampsia and seizure risk.
byChoice.zh: 暗点属于视觉症状，会增加对子痫前期重症及癫痫发作风险的担忧。

byChoice.en: New facial and periorbital edema is concerning when paired with severe BP and CNS symptoms.
byChoice.zh: 当新出现的面部和眼周水肿与重度血压和中枢神经症状同时出现时，具有警示意义。

byChoice.en: A BP of 162/108 includes a systolic value in the severe range and requires emergent evaluation in this symptom cluster.
byChoice.zh: BP 162/108 的收缩压已达重度范围，在这一症状组合下需要紧急评估。

byChoice.en: Light serosa is an expected postpartum lochia transition and does not explain the neurologic and BP findings.
byChoice.zh: 少量浆液性恶露是产后预期变化，不能解释神经系统和血压异常。

byChoice.en: Adequate voiding is reassuring for output, but it does not remove the need for emergency evaluation of severe BP and CNS symptoms.
byChoice.zh: 排尿充足对尿量有一定安慰意义，但不能取消对重度血压和中枢神经症状进行急诊评估的需要。

byChoice.en: Absence of chest pain is not enough to downgrade urgency when severe BP and CNS symptoms are present.
byChoice.zh: 在已有重度血压和中枢神经症状时，没有胸痛不足以降低紧急程度。

byChoice.en: Sleep deprivation is common postpartum, but it should not be used to dismiss a severe headache with visual symptoms and severe BP.
byChoice.zh: 产后睡眠不足很常见，但不能用来解释或忽视伴视觉症状和重度血压的严重头痛。

testTakingStrategy.en: In postpartum questions, do not normalize a headache when it is severe, unrelieved, paired with visual changes, or paired with severe-range BP.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到产后题目时，只要头痛严重、不能缓解、伴视觉改变或伴重度范围血压，就不要把它当作正常产后不适。

glossary.defZh: 视野中出现斑点、闪光或缺损，可提示子痫前期的神经系统受累。
通常指收缩压 ≥160 mm Hg 或舒张压 ≥110 mm Hg。
分娩后出现的高血压相关综合征，可伴头痛、视觉症状、蛋白尿或其他器官受累。

stem.en: At ED arrival, classify each cue according to how it should affect the nurse's interpretation before lab results are available.
stem.zh: 患者到达急诊时，在实验室结果尚未返回前，请判断每项线索对护士解释病情的意义。

rows.en: BP 168/112, repeated as 164/110 five minutes later
Headache 9/10 with intermittent visual spots
rows.zh: 头痛 9/10，伴间歇性视觉斑点

rows.en: DTRs 3+ with two beats of ankle clonus
rows.zh: 深腱反射 3+，踝阵挛 2 次

rows.en: Urine dipstick 3+ protein
rows.zh: 尿试纸蛋白 3+

rows.en: HELLP laboratory panel is still pending
rows.zh: HELLP 相关实验室检查仍未返回

columns.zh: 重度特征或需立即处理的线索

columns.en: Supportive but not required for immediate treatment
columns.zh: 有支持意义但不是立即处理的必要条件

correct.en: The repeated severe-range BP, CNS symptoms, and hyperreflexia with clonus are enough to classify the presentation as preeclampsia with severe features and begin urgent treatment. Proteinuria supports the diagnosis, but severe BP and CNS findings drive immediate action. Pending labs are drawn concurrently and should not delay treatment.
correct.zh: 反复重度范围 BP、中枢神经症状以及伴阵挛的反射亢进，足以将此表现判断为子痫前期伴重度特征并启动紧急治疗。蛋白尿支持诊断，但立即行动由重度 BP 和中枢神经发现驱动。实验室检查应同时进行，不能因此延误治疗。

byChoice.en: Both readings meet severe-range criteria because the systolic value is at least 160 and the diastolic value is at least 110.
byChoice.zh: 两次读数均符合重度范围，因为收缩压至少 160，舒张压至少 110。

byChoice.en: Severe headache and visual symptoms are CNS warning signs and raise concern for impending eclampsia.
byChoice.zh: 严重头痛和视觉症状是中枢神经系统警示征象，提示子痫风险升高。

byChoice.en: Hyperreflexia with clonus indicates CNS irritability and supports seizure-risk management.
byChoice.zh: 反射亢进伴阵挛提示中枢神经兴奋性增加，支持进行癫痫发作风险处理。

byChoice.en: Proteinuria supports preeclampsia, but severe-range BP with CNS symptoms already requires urgent action.
byChoice.zh: 蛋白尿支持子痫前期，但重度范围 BP 加中枢神经症状本身已需要紧急处理。

byChoice.en: Waiting for the HELLP panel would create an unsafe delay; labs are evaluated while treatment begins.
byChoice.zh: 等待 HELLP 检查结果会造成不安全延误；应在开始治疗的同时评估实验室结果。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a severe BP threshold and neurologic symptoms are present, act on the instability first; confirmatory labs should not become a prerequisite for safety treatment.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当出现重度血压阈值和神经系统症状时，先处理不稳定状态；确认性实验室检查不应成为安全治疗的前提。

glossary.defZh: 快速牵拉肌腱后出现的重复性不自主收缩，提示神经肌肉兴奋性增加。
以溶血、肝酶升高和血小板减少为特征的妊娠相关严重并发症。
尿中蛋白异常增多，可支持子痫前期诊断。

stem.en: Use the Stage 2 assessment and laboratory results to complete the diagnostic reasoning statement.
stem.zh: 根据第 2 阶段评估和实验室结果，完成诊断推理陈述。

clozeStem.en: The priority working diagnosis is {{dx}}. HELLP syndrome is less likely because {{hellp_evidence}}, and postpartum hypertension without severe features is less likely because {{severity_evidence}}.
clozeStem.zh: 优先工作诊断是 {{dx}}。HELLP 综合征可能性较低，因为 {{hellp_evidence}}；产后高血压不伴重度特征可能性较低，因为 {{severity_evidence}}。

options.en: postpartum hypertension without severe features
options.zh: 产后高血压不伴重度特征

options.en: HELLP syndrome
options.zh: HELLP 综合征

options.en: postpartum preeclampsia with severe features
options.zh: 产后子痫前期伴重度特征

options.en: urine protein-to-creatinine ratio is 0.42
options.zh: 尿蛋白/肌酐比值为 0.42

options.en: platelets, AST/ALT, and LDH are not showing the HELLP triad
options.zh: 血小板、AST/ALT 和 LDH 未显示 HELLP 三联征

options.en: uric acid is elevated
options.zh: 尿酸升高

options.en: the patient denies right upper quadrant pain
options.zh: 患者否认右上腹痛

options.en: severe-range BP is paired with headache, scotomata, hyperreflexia, and clonus
options.zh: 重度范围 BP 伴头痛、暗点、反射亢进和阵挛

options.en: the prenatal course was normotensive
options.zh: 孕期血压一直正常

correct.en: Stage 2 supports postpartum preeclampsia with severe features: severe-range BP, CNS symptoms, hyperreflexia with clonus, and proteinuria are present. HELLP is not supported because platelets, transaminases, and LDH are not showing the defining pattern. Hypertension without severe features is excluded by the severe BP and neurologic findings.
correct.zh: 第 2 阶段支持产后子痫前期伴重度特征：存在重度范围 BP、中枢神经症状、反射亢进伴阵挛以及蛋白尿。血小板、转氨酶和 LDH 未显示 HELLP 的特征模式，因此不支持 HELLP。重度 BP 和神经系统发现排除了“不伴重度特征”的高血压分类。

byChoice.en: The diagnosis dropdown is keyed to postpartum preeclampsia with severe features because severe BP and CNS findings are present after delivery.
byChoice.zh: 诊断下拉项选择产后子痫前期伴重度特征，因为分娩后出现重度 BP 和中枢神经发现。

byChoice.en: HELLP requires the hemolysis/liver-enzyme/platelet pattern; this case instead has normal platelets, near-normal transaminases, and normal LDH.
byChoice.zh: HELLP 需要溶血、肝酶升高和血小板减少的模式；本病例血小板正常，转氨酶接近正常，LDH 正常。

byChoice.en: The severe-range BP plus neurologic symptoms and clonus makes the severe-feature classification, not a mild postpartum hypertension classification.
byChoice.zh: 重度范围 BP 加神经系统症状和阵挛，决定了重度特征分类，而不是轻度产后高血压分类。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use abnormal defining criteria, not tempting associated findings, to separate competing diagnoses.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分竞争诊断时，要抓定义性异常标准，而不是被诱人的相关发现带偏。

glossary.defZh: AST 和 ALT 等肝细胞损伤指标。
可在溶血或组织损伤时升高；HELLP 评估中常用。
根据当前资料最优先采用、指导下一步处理的诊断。

stem.en: The patient asks, 'Will the magnesium bring my blood pressure down?' Which response by the nurse is best?
stem.zh: 患者问：“镁剂会把我的血压降下来吗？”护士哪项回答最佳？

options.en: Magnesium sulfate helps prevent seizures; the immediate-release nifedipine is the medication ordered to lower the blood pressure quickly.
options.zh: 硫酸镁用于帮助预防癫痫发作；医嘱中的速释硝苯地平才是用于快速降低血压的药物。

options.en: Because you are breastfeeding, both magnesium sulfate and nifedipine should be withheld until lactation consults.
options.zh: 因为你正在哺乳，应先停用硫酸镁和硝苯地平，等哺乳顾问评估后再说。

options.en: The extended-release nifedipine capsule would work just as well for this acute severe BP reading.
options.zh: 缓释硝苯地平胶囊对这次急性重度血压读数同样有效。

options.en: Magnesium sulfate is the main antihypertensive, so nifedipine can wait until the loading dose is complete.
options.zh: 硫酸镁是主要降压药，所以硝苯地平可以等负荷剂量结束后再给。

correct.en: Magnesium sulfate is used for seizure prophylaxis in preeclampsia with severe features; it is not the acute antihypertensive. Immediate-release nifedipine is ordered for rapid BP reduction, while extended-release nifedipine is for maintenance control later.
correct.zh: 硫酸镁用于子痫前期伴重度特征的癫痫发作预防；它不是急性降压药。速释硝苯地平的医嘱目的是快速降低 BP，而缓释硝苯地平用于后续维持控制。

byChoice.en: This repeats the unsafe misconception that magnesium is an antihypertensive and would delay BP treatment.
byChoice.zh: 这重复了“硫酸镁是降压药”的不安全误解，会延误血压治疗。

byChoice.en: Breastfeeding does not justify withholding urgently indicated seizure prophylaxis and antihypertensive therapy; lactation support can occur alongside treatment.
byChoice.zh: 哺乳并不能成为停用紧急所需癫痫预防和降压治疗的理由；哺乳支持可以与治疗同时进行。

byChoice.en: Extended-release nifedipine is not interchangeable with immediate-release nifedipine for acute severe BP reduction.
byChoice.zh: 在急性重度 BP 降压中，缓释硝苯地平不能替代速释硝苯地平。

byChoice.en: This accurately separates seizure prophylaxis from BP control and reinforces the immediate-release nifedipine order.
byChoice.zh: 这准确区分了癫痫预防和血压控制，并强调速释硝苯地平医嘱。

testTakingStrategy.en: Match each medication to its purpose before deciding whether it can be delayed or substituted.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 判断药物能否延迟或替代前，先把每种药物与其治疗目的对应起来。

glossary.defZh: 在子痫前期重症中用于预防或治疗癫痫发作的高警示药物。
药物释放较快，适用于需要较快起效的情境。
用于降低血压的药物。

stem.en: At 11:40 AM, the nurse is initiating treatment for confirmed severe-range BP and seizure risk. Which actions should the nurse include now? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 11:40 AM，护士正在为已确认的重度范围 BP 和癫痫发作风险启动治疗。护士现在应包括哪些措施？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Implement seizure precautions, including padded side rails, suction at bedside, dim lighting, and minimized stimulation.
options.zh: 实施癫痫预防措施，包括床栏加垫、床旁备吸引、调暗灯光并减少刺激。

options.en: Monitor BP every 5 minutes for the first 20 minutes, then as ordered.
options.zh: 前 20 分钟每 5 分钟监测 BP，之后按医嘱监测。

options.en: Run the magnesium by gravity tubing to save time if the pump is not immediately nearby.
options.zh: 如果输液泵不在旁边，为节省时间用重力输液管滴注硫酸镁。

options.en: Start the magnesium sulfate loading dose by infusion pump as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱用输液泵开始硫酸镁负荷剂量。

options.en: Wait until the magnesium loading dose is complete before giving nifedipine.
options.zh: 等硫酸镁负荷剂量完成后再给予硝苯地平。

options.en: Administer the immediate-release nifedipine 10 mg PO as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱给予速释硝苯地平 10 mg PO。

correct.en: These are concurrent priorities: start magnesium safely by pump for seizure prophylaxis, give immediate-release nifedipine for acute BP reduction, create a low-stimulation seizure-safe environment, and perform close serial BP monitoring. The nurse should not force a sequence that delays either medication or safety precautions.
correct.zh: 这些是同时进行的优先措施：用输液泵安全启动硫酸镁以预防癫痫，给予速释硝苯地平进行急性降压，建立低刺激且防癫痫的环境，并密切连续监测 BP。护士不应人为设置顺序而延误任一药物或安全措施。

byChoice.en: Gravity tubing is unsafe for a high-alert magnesium infusion because accurate rate control is essential.
byChoice.zh: 硫酸镁为高警示输注药物，必须精确控制速率，用重力滴注不安全。

byChoice.en: The antihypertensive should be given promptly; it should not wait for completion of the magnesium loading dose.
byChoice.zh: 降压药应及时给予；不应等硫酸镁负荷剂量结束后再给。

byChoice.en: Frequent BP monitoring evaluates response and detects persistent severe hypertension or hypotension after treatment.
byChoice.zh: 频繁 BP 监测可评估疗效，并发现治疗后持续重度高血压或低血压。

byChoice.en: Waiting for the magnesium load to finish would delay acute BP treatment during the highest-risk window.
byChoice.zh: 等待硫酸镁负荷完成会在最高风险窗口延误急性降压治疗。

byChoice.en: Seizure precautions reduce injury risk during the period of high CNS irritability.
byChoice.zh: 在中枢神经兴奋性高的时期，癫痫预防措施可降低受伤风险。

byChoice.en: Magnesium is a high-alert infusion and should be administered by pump at the ordered loading rate.
byChoice.zh: 硫酸镁是高警示输注药物，应按医嘱负荷速率用输液泵给药。

testTakingStrategy.en: When interventions protect against different immediate risks, decide whether they are concurrent rather than forcing an ordered-response mindset.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多项干预分别针对不同的即时风险时，要判断它们是否应并行，而不是强行套用排序思维。

glossary.defZh: 降低癫痫发作时受伤和误吸风险的环境与设备准备。
用于精确控制静脉输液速率的设备。
按短间隔重复测量血压以评估趋势和治疗反应。

stem.en: At 1:30 PM, classify each reassessment finding as evidence of improvement/absence of toxicity, a finding requiring continued vigilance, or a finding that is not an acute treatment-response marker.
stem.zh: 1:30 PM，请将每项复评发现归类为改善/无中毒证据、需要继续警惕的发现，或不是急性治疗反应指标的发现。

rows.en: BP has decreased to 138/88
rows.zh: BP 已降至 138/88

rows.en: Visual spots have resolved and headache is now 4/10
rows.zh: 视觉斑点已消失，头痛现为 4/10

rows.en: DTRs are 2+ with no clonus
rows.zh: 深腱反射 2+，无阵挛

rows.en: Respiratory rate is 16/min and the patient is alert
rows.zh: 呼吸频率 16 次/分，患者清醒

rows.en: Urine output is 45 mL in the second hour
rows.zh: 第二小时尿量为 45 mL

rows.en: Facial edema is unchanged
rows.zh: 面部水肿无变化

correct.en: BP below the severe range, improved headache/visual symptoms, normalized reflexes without clonus, and stable respirations/mentation indicate treatment response and no current magnesium toxicity. Urine output of 45 mL/hr is above the usual minimum for magnesium clearance but still requires close hourly monitoring. Facial edema often resolves over days and is not the acute marker of response.
correct.zh: BP 低于重度范围、头痛/视觉症状改善、反射恢复且无阵挛、呼吸和意识稳定，提示治疗有效且目前无镁中毒。45 mL/小时的尿量高于通常用于镁清除的最低值，但仍需每小时密切监测。面部水肿常需数天缓解，不是急性治疗反应指标。

byChoice.en: The immediate BP goal is to move out of the severe range while avoiding hypotension.
byChoice.zh: 即时 BP 目标是脱离重度范围，同时避免低血压。

byChoice.en: Resolution of visual symptoms and a lower headache score suggest decreasing CNS irritability.
byChoice.zh: 视觉症状消失且头痛评分降低，提示中枢神经兴奋性下降。

byChoice.en: DTRs that remain present and clonus that resolves support improvement and do not suggest magnesium toxicity.
byChoice.zh: 深腱反射仍存在且阵挛消失，支持病情改善，并不提示镁中毒。

byChoice.en: Stable respirations and alert mentation are key safety checks during magnesium therapy.
byChoice.zh: 呼吸稳定和意识清醒是硫酸镁治疗期间的关键安全检查。

byChoice.en: Urine output is adequate for now but must be trended because magnesium is renally cleared and oliguria increases toxicity risk.
byChoice.zh: 目前尿量尚可，但必须持续观察趋势，因为镁经肾脏清除，少尿会增加中毒风险。

byChoice.en: Persistent facial edema does not mean treatment failure in the first hours; it is not the acute response marker.
byChoice.zh: 最初数小时面部水肿持续存在并不代表治疗失败；它不是急性反应指标。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes using the parameter tied to the immediate goal: BP and neurologic signs for preeclampsia response, respirations/reflexes/urine output for magnesium safety.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果时，要使用与即时目标相关的指标：用 BP 和神经系统体征判断子痫前期反应，用呼吸、反射和尿量判断硫酸镁安全性。

glossary.defZh: 硫酸镁水平过高导致反射消失、呼吸抑制、意识改变等危险表现。
反映肾灌注和药物清除能力的重要监测指标。
干预后病情朝预期方向改善的证据。

correct.en: This case requires recognizing late postpartum preeclampsia with severe features despite a normotensive pregnancy and recent discharge. The urgent cues are severe headache unrelieved by analgesic, scotomata, new facial edema, repeated severe-range BP, and later hyperreflexia with clonus. Management is not delayed for labs: magnesium sulfate is used for seizure prophylaxis, immediate-release nifedipine is used for acute BP reduction, seizure precautions and close BP monitoring occur concurrently, and response is evaluated by BP trend, CNS symptom improvement, reflex/clonus status, respirations/mentation, and urine output rather than rapid resolution of edema.
correct.zh: 本病例要求即使患者孕期血压正常且刚出院，也要识别迟发性产后子痫前期伴重度特征。紧急线索包括止痛药不能缓解的严重头痛、暗点、新出现面部水肿、反复重度范围 BP，以及随后出现的反射亢进伴阵挛。处理不能等待实验室结果：硫酸镁用于癫痫预防，速释硝苯地平用于急性降压，癫痫预防措施和密切 BP 监测应并行进行；疗效评估看 BP 趋势、中枢神经症状改善、反射/阵挛状态、呼吸/意识和尿量，而不是期待水肿快速消退。

testTakingStrategy.en: For postpartum emergencies, compare reported symptoms against severe-feature clusters, then match each intervention to the risk it prevents: seizure, stroke, injury, or medication toxicity.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理产后急症题时，先把报告的症状与重度特征组合比较，再把每项干预对应到它预防的风险：癫痫发作、中风、受伤或药物中毒。

glossary.defZh: 产后 48 小时后至数周内出现的子痫前期表现。
提示器官受累或严重风险的表现，如重度范围血压、严重头痛、视觉症状或神经系统兴奋性增加。
钙通道阻滞剂，可用于妊娠或产后高血压的血压控制；急性处理需按医嘱使用速释剂型。
用于评估溶血、肝酶升高和血小板减少的实验室检查组合。

title.en: Acute hemolytic transfusion reaction following ABO-incompatible red blood cell transfusion
title.zh: ABO 不相容红细胞输注后的急性溶血性输血反应

summary.en: A 58-year-old woman with CKD stage 3b, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes is admitted for symptomatic anemia. Her true blood type is A-positive, but a mislabeled pretransfusion specimen leads to issue of an ABO-incompatible packed red blood cell unit. The transfusion begins at 1420 through a 20-gauge peripheral IV.
summary.zh: 一名 58 岁女性，有 3b 期慢性肾病、高血压和 2 型糖尿病，因症状性贫血入院。患者真实血型为 A 阳性，但输血前标本采集时贴错标签，导致发出 ABO 不相容的浓缩红细胞。输血于 1420 经 20G 外周 IV 开始。

content.en:
Reason for admission: symptomatic anemia with fatigue, exertional dyspnea, and pallor for 2 weeks.
Ordered therapy: two units packed red blood cells; initial transfusion rate 2 mL/min for the first 15 minutes per facility protocol.
Baseline vital signs: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 92/min, BP 108/68 mmHg, RR 18/min, SpO2 96% on room air.
Assessment: alert and oriented, lungs clear, skin pale/warm/dry, abdomen soft and non-tender, no edema, IV site without redness/swelling/tenderness.
Urine output: about 40 mL/hr, straw-colored urine.
Admission labs: Hgb 6.4 g/dL, Hct 19.2%, WBC 7.8 ×10³/µL, platelets 218 ×10³/µL, BUN 32 mg/dL, creatinine 1.8 mg/dL, K 4.6 mEq/L, total bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL, LDH 190 U/L, INR 1.0, aPTT 28 sec, fibrinogen 310 mg/dL, haptoglobin 95 mg/dL. Urinalysis yellow/clear, no blood.
content.zh:
入院原因：症状性贫血，2 周来乏力、活动后气促、面色苍白。
医嘱治疗：输注 2 单位浓缩红细胞；按机构流程，前 15 分钟初始速率为 2 mL/min。
基线生命体征：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 92 次/分，BP 108/68 mmHg，RR 18 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 96%。
评估：清醒定向，双肺清，皮肤苍白但温暖干燥，腹部软且无压痛，无水肿，IV 部位无发红/肿胀/压痛。
尿量：约 40 mL/hr，尿液稻草色。
入院实验室：Hgb 6.4 g/dL，Hct 19.2%，WBC 7.8 ×10³/µL，血小板 218 ×10³/µL，BUN 32 mg/dL，肌酐 1.8 mg/dL，K 4.6 mEq/L，总胆红素 0.9 mg/dL，LDH 190 U/L，INR 1.0，aPTT 28 秒，纤维蛋白原 310 mg/dL，结合珠蛋白 95 mg/dL。尿检黄色清亮，无血。

title.zh: 第1阶段：输血开始后 12 分钟（1432）

content.en: The client presses the call light and reports sudden deep low back pain across both flanks. She says, "something is wrong — I feel like something terrible is about to happen." She is visibly shivering and reports feeling cold despite warm blankets. Face and chest are flushed; early diaphoresis and mild nausea are present. Vital signs: T 101.5 °F (38.6 °C), HR 118/min, BP 96/58 mmHg, RR 24/min, SpO2 95% on room air. IV site remains unchanged with no redness, swelling, or streaking. About 25 mL of the unit has infused. The urine in the bedside commode from the most recent void is dark reddish-brown.
content.zh: 患者按铃，诉双侧腰部突然出现深部下背痛。她说：“不对劲——我觉得要出大事了。”患者明显发抖，即使盖着暖毯仍觉得冷。面部和胸部潮红，早期出汗，轻度恶心。生命体征：T 101.5 °F (38.6 °C)，HR 118 次/分，BP 96/58 mmHg，RR 24 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 95%。IV 部位无变化，无发红、肿胀或条索状红线。约 25 mL 血液已输入。床旁便盆中最近一次尿液呈深红褐色。

title.en: Stage 2: 30 minutes after transfusion stopped and saline bolus started (about 1505)
title.zh: 第2阶段：停止输血并开始生理盐水快速输注后 30 分钟（约 1505）

title.en: Worsening shock, renal findings, and coagulopathy
title.zh: 休克、肾脏表现和凝血障碍恶化

content.en:
The provider is at the bedside. The client is increasingly restless, reports worsening flank pain and chest tightness, and speaks in fragmented phrases. Vital signs: T 102.4 °F (39.1 °C), HR 132/min, BP 82/50 mmHg, RR 28/min, SpO2 93% on 4 L nasal cannula. Extremities are mottled with cool fingers and toes despite truncal flushing. Foley catheter drainage: initial 20 mL dark port-wine urine, then only 10 mL over the next 30 minutes. New oozing is present from the peripheral IV insertion site and a venipuncture site; petechiae are appearing across the anterior chest.
Stat labs: Hgb 5.8 g/dL, platelets 104 ×10³/µL, K 5.4 mEq/L, creatinine 2.6 mg/dL, total bilirubin 4.2 mg/dL, LDH 1,840 U/L, INR 1.8, aPTT 52 sec, fibrinogen 140 mg/dL, haptoglobin <10 mg/dL, free plasma hemoglobin elevated. Blood bank requests the discontinued unit with attached tubing, a post-reaction blood sample from the opposite arm, and the original pretransfusion specimen.
content.zh:
医护提供者已在床旁。患者越来越烦躁，诉腰痛加重并有胸闷，说话断续。生命体征：T 102.4 °F (39.1 °C)，HR 132 次/分，BP 82/50 mmHg，RR 28 次/分，鼻导管 4 L/min 下 SpO2 93%。四肢呈花斑，手指和脚趾冰凉，但躯干仍潮红。Foley 导尿：初始引流 20 mL 深葡萄酒色尿，随后 30 分钟仅 10 mL。外周 IV 穿刺处和抽血穿刺处新出现渗血；前胸出现瘀点。
急查实验室：Hgb 5.8 g/dL，血小板 104 ×10³/µL，K 5.4 mEq/L，肌酐 2.6 mg/dL，总胆红素 4.2 mg/dL，LDH 1,840 U/L，INR 1.8，aPTT 52 秒，纤维蛋白原 140 mg/dL，结合珠蛋白 <10 mg/dL，游离血浆血红蛋白升高。血库要求送回已停止输注的血袋及连接管路、从对侧手臂采集输血反应后血样，以及原输血前标本。

title.zh: 第3阶段：停止输血后 2 小时（约 1620）

title.en: ICU course and confirmed ABO incompatibility
title.zh: ICU 经过和 ABO 不相容确认

content.en: The client has been transferred to the ICU after receiving 1,500 mL normal saline. A central venous catheter has been placed, and norepinephrine is infusing at 0.08 mcg/kg/min to maintain MAP above 65 mmHg per ICU protocol. The blood bank confirms the client is A-positive and the transfused unit was B-positive. Current vital signs: T 101.1 °F (38.4 °C), HR 120/min, BP 88/56 mmHg on norepinephrine, RR 24/min on 6 L nasal cannula, SpO2 94%. Urine output over the past hour is 8 mL, dark amber and hemoglobin-positive by dipstick. Repeat labs: Hgb 5.2 g/dL, platelets 78 ×10³/µL, K 5.9 mEq/L, creatinine 3.4 mg/dL, total bilirubin 6.1 mg/dL, LDH 2,600 U/L, INR 2.2, aPTT 68 sec, fibrinogen 88 mg/dL. The client is drowsy but arousable, oriented to person only. Peripheral pulses are thready; mottling extends to knees and elbows; oozing continues from catheter sites. ICU team is evaluating for emergent dialysis and blood component therapy.
content.zh: 患者已转入 ICU，已接受 1,500 mL 生理盐水。已置入中心静脉导管，并按 ICU 流程使用去甲肾上腺素 0.08 mcg/kg/min 以维持 MAP >65 mmHg。血库确认患者为 A 阳性，输注血袋为 B 阳性。当前生命体征：T 101.1 °F (38.4 °C)，HR 120 次/分，使用去甲肾上腺素时 BP 88/56 mmHg，鼻导管 6 L/min 下 RR 24 次/分、SpO2 94%。过去 1 小时尿量 8 mL，深琥珀色，尿试纸血红蛋白阳性。复查实验室：Hgb 5.2 g/dL，血小板 78 ×10³/µL，K 5.9 mEq/L，肌酐 3.4 mg/dL，总胆红素 6.1 mg/dL，LDH 2,600 U/L，INR 2.2，aPTT 68 秒，纤维蛋白原 88 mg/dL。患者嗜睡但可唤醒，仅能说出自己是谁。外周脉搏细弱；花斑延伸至膝部和肘部；导管部位仍渗血。ICU 团队正在评估是否需紧急透析和血液成分治疗。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: Using the Stage 1 update, highlight the findings that are significant cues requiring immediate nursing action.
stem.zh: 根据第1阶段更新，标出需要护士立即处理的重要线索。

segments.en: Sudden deep bilateral flank and low back pain during the transfusion.
segments.zh: 输血过程中突然出现双侧腰背部深部疼痛。

segments.en: The client states, "something is wrong — I feel like something terrible is about to happen."
segments.zh: 患者说：“不对劲——我觉得要出大事了。”

segments.en: Visible rigors with temperature rising from 98.2 °F (36.8 °C) to 101.5 °F (38.6 °C).
Heart rate increases from 92/min to 118/min.
segments.zh: 心率从 92 次/分升至 118 次/分。

segments.en: Blood pressure decreases from 108/68 mmHg to 96/58 mmHg.
segments.zh: 血压从 108/68 mmHg 降至 96/58 mmHg。

segments.en: The most recent urine appears dark reddish-brown.
segments.zh: 最近一次尿液呈深红褐色。

segments.en: The peripheral IV site has no redness, swelling, or streaking.
segments.zh: 外周 IV 部位无发红、肿胀或条索状红线。

correct.en: The cue cluster is abrupt flank/back pain, a sense of impending doom, fever with rigors, tachycardia, falling blood pressure, and dark reddish-brown urine within minutes of starting blood. This pattern requires the nurse to treat the event as an acute transfusion reaction and stop the transfusion immediately. The normal IV site is useful because it makes infiltration or phlebitis less likely, but it is not itself a danger cue.
correct.zh: 关键线索组合是在输血开始后数分钟内突然出现腰背痛、濒危感、发热寒战、心动过速、血压下降和深红褐色尿液。护士应按急性输血反应处理，立即停止输血。IV 部位正常有助于排除渗漏或静脉炎，但它本身不是危险线索。

byChoice.en: Acute flank or low back pain during a transfusion is a high-risk cue for intravascular hemolysis and renal involvement.
byChoice.zh: 输血时急性腰部或下背痛是血管内溶血和肾脏受累的高危线索。

byChoice.en: A sudden sense of impending doom during a transfusion is a classic subjective warning sign of a severe acute reaction.
byChoice.zh: 输血过程中突然出现濒危感，是严重急性反应的典型主观警讯。

byChoice.en: A rapid temperature rise with rigors during blood administration indicates an acute transfusion reaction until proven otherwise.
byChoice.zh: 输血期间体温快速升高并伴寒战，应首先视为急性输血反应。

byChoice.en: The new tachycardia is part of the systemic reaction and may reflect early shock.
byChoice.zh: 新发心动过速属于全身反应的一部分，可能提示早期休克。

byChoice.en: A falling blood pressure during the reaction signals loss of perfusion and a potentially life-threatening trajectory.
byChoice.zh: 反应过程中血压下降提示灌注不足，病情可能危及生命。

byChoice.en: Dark reddish-brown urine suggests hemoglobinuria, which strongly supports intravascular hemolysis.
byChoice.zh: 深红褐色尿提示血红蛋白尿，强烈支持血管内溶血。

byChoice.en: A normal IV site does not explain the systemic symptoms; it is not a cue that requires emergency action by itself.
byChoice.zh: IV 部位正常不能解释全身症状；它本身不是需要紧急处理的线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: During a transfusion, sudden systemic changes are more important than a normal IV site. Link timing plus cue cluster before deciding the priority.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 输血过程中，突然出现的全身变化比 IV 部位正常更重要。先把发生时间和线索组合联系起来，再判断优先级。

glossary.defZh: 强烈、不可控制的发抖，常提示急性发热或感染/输血反应。
游离血红蛋白经肾脏排出，使尿液呈红褐色。
患者突然强烈感觉将发生严重危险，可见于严重急性反应。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: At Stage 1, which transfusion reaction is most consistent with fever and rigors, bilateral flank pain, hypotension, a sense of impending doom, and dark reddish-brown urine 12 minutes after the transfusion begins?
stem.zh: 第1阶段，输血开始 12 分钟后出现发热寒战、双侧腰痛、低血压、濒危感和深红褐色尿液，最符合哪一种输血反应？

options.en: Febrile non-hemolytic transfusion reaction
options.zh: 非溶血性发热性输血反应

options.en: Mild allergic transfusion reaction
options.zh: 轻度过敏性输血反应

options.en: Delayed hemolytic transfusion reaction
options.zh: 迟发性溶血性输血反应

options.en: Transfusion-associated circulatory overload
options.zh: 输血相关循环超负荷

options.en: Acute hemolytic transfusion reaction
options.zh: 急性溶血性输血反应

correct.en: The most consistent diagnosis is an acute hemolytic transfusion reaction. The decisive features are very rapid onset during transfusion, flank/back pain, hypotension, hemoglobinuria, fever with rigors, and a sense of impending doom. These findings fit acute intravascular hemolysis from incompatible red cells.
correct.zh: 最符合的是急性溶血性输血反应。关键特征是输血过程中快速发作、腰背痛、低血压、血红蛋白尿、发热寒战和濒危感。这些符合不相容红细胞导致的急性血管内溶血。

byChoice.en: A febrile non-hemolytic reaction can cause fever and chills, but it does not explain hemoglobinuria, flank pain, or shock.
byChoice.zh: 非溶血性发热反应可有发热寒战，但不能解释血红蛋白尿、腰痛或休克。

byChoice.en: A delayed hemolytic reaction occurs days to weeks later, not within 12 minutes of beginning the transfusion.
byChoice.zh: 迟发性溶血反应发生在数天到数周后，而不是输血开始 12 分钟内。

byChoice.en: TACO is suggested by dyspnea, crackles, jugular venous distension, fluid overload, and often hypertension rather than hemoglobinuria and flank pain.
byChoice.zh: TACO 通常由呼吸困难、湿啰音、颈静脉怒张、容量超负荷及常见高血压提示，而不是血红蛋白尿和腰痛。

byChoice.en: A mild allergic reaction usually causes urticaria, itching, and flushing; it does not cause hemoglobinuria or bilateral flank pain.
byChoice.zh: 轻度过敏反应通常表现为荨麻疹、瘙痒和潮红；不会导致血红蛋白尿或双侧腰痛。

byChoice.en: This is correct because hemoglobinuria plus flank pain and hemodynamic instability during the first minutes of transfusion strongly indicates acute intravascular hemolysis.
byChoice.zh: 正确。输血最初数分钟内出现血红蛋白尿、腰痛和血流动力学不稳定，强烈提示急性血管内溶血。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not stop at the word fever. Hemoglobinuria and flank pain shift the diagnosis from a simple febrile reaction to hemolysis.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要只看到“发热”。血红蛋白尿和腰痛会把判断从单纯发热反应转向溶血反应。

glossary.defZh: 输注不相容血液后红细胞被迅速破坏的严重反应。
供受者 ABO 血型不匹配，可引起严重溶血。
肾区疼痛；在溶血时可与肾脏受累有关。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: At Stage 1, which problem is the most immediately life-threatening and should drive the nurse's priority response?
stem.zh: 第1阶段，哪一个问题最直接危及生命，应该决定护士的优先处理？

options.en: The dark reddish-brown urine
options.zh: 深红褐色尿液

options.en: The normal-appearing IV site
options.zh: IV 部位外观正常

options.en: The fever and rigors
options.zh: 发热和寒战

options.en: The client's nausea
options.zh: 患者恶心

options.en: The acute hypotension with tachycardia
options.zh: 急性低血压伴心动过速

correct.en: The immediate threat is cardiovascular collapse: the blood pressure is falling while the heart rate is rising. Fever and hemoglobinuria are important, but inadequate perfusion can become fatal within minutes and must drive the response to stop the antigen exposure and support circulation.
correct.zh: 最直接的威胁是循环崩溃：血压下降同时心率升高。发热和血红蛋白尿很重要，但灌注不足可在数分钟内危及生命，因此处理重点是停止继续接触抗原并支持循环。

byChoice.en: Nausea is uncomfortable but is not the immediate threat compared with shock and ongoing hemolysis.
byChoice.zh: 恶心会造成不适，但与休克和持续溶血相比，不是最直接威胁。

byChoice.en: Hemoglobinuria indicates hemolysis and renal risk, but circulation must be supported first so the kidneys can be perfused.
byChoice.zh: 血红蛋白尿提示溶血和肾损伤风险，但必须先维持循环灌注，肾脏才有灌注。

byChoice.en: The normal IV site rules against a local IV complication; it is not the life-threatening problem.
byChoice.zh: IV 部位正常有助于排除局部 IV 并发症；它不是危及生命的问题。

byChoice.en: This is correct because hypotension with tachycardia signals shock physiology and loss of adequate tissue perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 正确。低血压伴心动过速提示休克生理和组织灌注不足。

byChoice.en: Fever and rigors help identify the reaction, but temperature control is not the first survival priority.
byChoice.zh: 发热寒战有助于识别反应，但退热不是最优先生命支持问题。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several abnormal findings are present, ask which one can kill the client first. Shock physiology outranks fever control.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 多个异常同时存在时，先问哪一个会最快危及生命。休克生理优先于退热处理。

glossary.defZh: 循环系统不能维持足够组织灌注的危急状态。
血液向组织输送氧气和营养的过程。
组织灌注不足导致细胞缺氧和器官功能障碍的状态。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: At Stage 1, which actions should the nurse take immediately? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第1阶段，护士应立即采取哪些措施？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Remove the peripheral IV catheter because the line has been exposed to incompatible blood.
options.zh: 因为该管路接触过不相容血液，所以拔除外周 IV 导管。

options.en: Disconnect the blood tubing and keep the IV open with 0.9% normal saline through new tubing per protocol.
options.zh: 断开输血管路，并按流程用新的管路接 0.9% 生理盐水维持 IV 通路。

options.en: Clamp the blood tubing and stop the transfusion.
options.zh: 夹闭输血管路并停止输血。

options.en: Save the blood unit with attached tubing and labels for the blood bank investigation.
options.zh: 保留血袋、连接管路和标签，供血库调查。

options.en: Flush the blood remaining in the original tubing before switching to saline.
options.zh: 在换接生理盐水前，先把原管路中剩余的血液冲入体内。

options.en: Stay with the client and have another staff member notify the provider and blood bank.
options.zh: 留在患者身边，并请另一名工作人员通知医护提供者和血库。

correct.en: The nurse should stop the transfusion, maintain venous access with 0.9% normal saline using new tubing according to protocol, notify the provider and blood bank while staying with the client, and preserve the unit/tubing/labels. The nurse should not flush the original tubing because that would infuse more incompatible blood, and should not remove the IV because the client is hypotensive and needs access.
correct.zh: 护士应停止输血，按流程使用新管路和 0.9% 生理盐水维持静脉通路，留在患者身边并通知医护提供者和血库，同时保留血袋、管路和标签。不能冲洗原输血管路，因为会把更多不相容血液输入体内；也不应拔除 IV，因为患者低血压，需要静脉通路。

byChoice.en: Removing the IV loses needed venous access in a hypotensive client who may require fluids, medications, and blood components.
byChoice.zh: 拔除 IV 会失去必要静脉通路；低血压患者可能需要补液、用药和血液成分治疗。

byChoice.en: New tubing with 0.9% normal saline maintains access and avoids flushing residual blood from the transfusion tubing.
byChoice.zh: 使用新管路接 0.9% 生理盐水可维持通路，并避免冲入输血管路中的残余血液。

byChoice.en: The client is unstable; the nurse should remain with the client and delegate notification when possible.
byChoice.zh: 患者不稳定；护士应留在患者身边，并在可能时委派他人通知。

byChoice.en: The blood bank needs the unit, tubing, and labels intact to investigate the incompatibility and reaction.
byChoice.zh: 血库需要完整的血袋、管路和标签来调查不相容和输血反应。

byChoice.en: This is unsafe because any additional incompatible blood can worsen the hemolytic reaction.
byChoice.zh: 不安全。任何额外的不相容血液都可能加重溶血反应。

byChoice.en: Stopping the transfusion immediately stops additional incompatible red cells from entering the client.
byChoice.zh: 立即停止输血可阻止更多不相容红细胞进入患者体内。

testTakingStrategy.en: For a suspected severe transfusion reaction, do four things together: stop blood, keep access safely, call for help, and preserve evidence.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 疑似严重输血反应时同时抓住四点：停血、以安全方式保留通路、呼叫支援、保留证据。

glossary.defZh: 常用于输血相关 IV 管路管理的等渗晶体液。
对血袋、管路、标签和患者样本进行核查，以确认反应原因。
用于输液、给药或输血的静脉管路。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: At Stage 2, the client remains hypotensive despite initial saline, has worsening oliguria with port-wine urine, oozing from puncture sites, petechiae, and labs consistent with hemolysis and evolving DIC. What is the nurse's priority action?
stem.zh: 第2阶段，患者经初始生理盐水处理后仍低血压，少尿加重且尿呈葡萄酒色，穿刺部位渗血、出现瘀点，实验室结果符合溶血和进展性 DIC。护士的优先措施是什么？

options.en: Hold further interventions until the blood bank confirms the exact incompatibility.
options.zh: 等待血库确认具体不相容类型后再进行进一步干预。

options.en: Escalate immediately for rapid response or ICU-level care while continuing perfusion support and strict output monitoring.
options.zh: 立即升级处理，启动快速反应或转入 ICU 级别护理，同时继续支持灌注并严格监测尿量。

options.en: Administer acetaminophen and reassess the temperature in 30 minutes.
options.zh: 给予对乙酰氨基酚，并在 30 分钟后复测体温。

options.en: Slow the saline infusion because chronic kidney disease makes fluid overload the main priority.
options.zh: 因患者有慢性肾病，应减慢生理盐水输注，因为容量超负荷是主要优先问题。

options.en: Complete the transfusion reaction documentation before further escalation.
options.zh: 先完成输血反应记录表，再进一步升级处理。

correct.en: The client is deteriorating with shock, oliguric acute kidney injury, and DIC despite the initial correct response. The nurse should escalate immediately to rapid response or ICU-level care, continue ordered perfusion support, measure urine output closely, and ensure the blood bank workup and compatible components are moving. Documentation and antipyretics must not delay escalation.
correct.zh: 患者在初步正确处理后仍出现休克、少尿性急性肾损伤和 DIC，说明病情恶化。护士应立即启动快速反应或 ICU 级别护理，继续按医嘱支持灌注，严密测量尿量，并确保血库调查和相容血液成分准备正在进行。记录和退热不能延误升级处理。

byChoice.en: This is correct because worsening hypotension, oliguria, and coagulopathy require higher-acuity monitoring and interventions.
byChoice.zh: 正确。低血压、少尿和凝血障碍恶化，需要更高级别监护和干预。

byChoice.en: The client has renal disease, but the immediate problem is poor perfusion and shock; fluids are guided by orders/protocol and ongoing assessment.
byChoice.zh: 患者有肾病，但当前直接问题是灌注不足和休克；补液应按医嘱/流程并结合持续评估。

byChoice.en: Treating fever alone misses the life-threatening shock, renal injury, and DIC.
byChoice.zh: 单纯退热会漏掉危及生命的休克、肾损伤和 DIC。

byChoice.en: The nurse should not wait for final confirmation when the client is actively deteriorating.
byChoice.zh: 患者正在恶化时，护士不应等待最终确认才处理。

byChoice.en: Documentation is required, but it must not delay escalation for an unstable client.
byChoice.zh: 记录是必要的，但不能延误对不稳定患者的升级处理。

testTakingStrategy.en: When initial measures fail and multiple organ systems are worsening, choose escalation rather than task completion or symptom-only care.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 初步处理无效且多个器官系统恶化时，应选择升级处理，而不是先完成文书或只处理单一症状。

glossary.defZh: 凝血系统广泛激活导致血栓形成和凝血因子消耗，可出现出血。
尿量明显减少，成人常以每小时尿量过低作为警讯。
针对病情突然恶化患者启动的院内紧急评估和支援流程。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: At Stage 3, classify each finding as evidence of stabilization, evidence of continued deterioration, or insufficient by itself to show stabilization.
stem.zh: 第3阶段，请判断每项发现是提示病情稳定、继续恶化，还是单独看不足以说明病情稳定。

rows.en: Urine output is 8 mL in the past hour with persistent hemoglobin-positive dark urine.
rows.zh: 过去 1 小时尿量 8 mL，尿液仍深色且血红蛋白阳性。

rows.en: Blood pressure is maintained while norepinephrine requirements are decreasing.
rows.zh: 血压可维持，同时去甲肾上腺素需求量正在下降。

rows.en: Fibrinogen is rising while INR and aPTT are falling toward baseline.
rows.zh: 纤维蛋白原上升，同时 INR 和 aPTT 正向基线下降。

rows.en: Potassium has increased to 5.9 mEq/L with worsening creatinine.
rows.zh: 钾升至 5.9 mEq/L，肌酐继续恶化。

rows.en: Temperature has decreased from 102.4 °F (39.1 °C) to 101.1 °F (38.4 °C).

columns.zh: 单独看不足以判断稳定

correct.en: Stabilization would be shown by improving perfusion with lower vasopressor needs, improving urine output, and improving coagulation and electrolyte trends. At Stage 3, persistent oliguria with hemoglobinuria, rising creatinine, rising potassium, and worsening coagulation show deterioration. A modest temperature decrease alone does not prove recovery.
correct.zh: 病情稳定应表现为灌注改善且升压药需求下降、尿量改善、凝血和电解质趋势改善。第3阶段持续少尿伴血红蛋白尿、肌酐升高、钾升高和凝血恶化提示继续恶化。体温略降本身不能证明恢复。

byChoice.en: Persistent oliguria with hemoglobin-positive dark urine indicates ongoing renal hypoperfusion and hemoglobin-mediated injury.
byChoice.zh: 持续少尿且尿血红蛋白阳性，提示肾灌注不足和血红蛋白介导损伤仍在进行。

byChoice.en: Maintaining pressure with less vasopressor support would indicate improving cardiovascular stability.
byChoice.zh: 在升压药需求减少的情况下维持血压，提示循环稳定性改善。

byChoice.en: Rising fibrinogen with improving clotting times suggests the consumptive coagulopathy is stabilizing.
byChoice.zh: 纤维蛋白原上升且凝血时间改善，提示消耗性凝血障碍趋于稳定。

byChoice.en: Rising potassium with worsening creatinine indicates worsening renal failure and dyskalemia risk.
byChoice.zh: 钾升高并伴肌酐恶化，提示肾衰竭加重和电解质危险。

byChoice.en: A lower temperature may be reassuring, but by itself it does not outweigh worsening renal, coagulation, and perfusion data.
byChoice.zh: 体温下降可能令人稍安心，但单独看不能抵消肾脏、凝血和灌注数据恶化。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by trends in threatened organ systems, not by one improving vital sign.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评价结果时看受威胁器官系统的趋势，不要只看一个好转的生命体征。

glossary.defZh: 凝血所需蛋白；DIC 中可被消耗而下降。
反映凝血途径功能的实验室指标，升高表示凝血时间延长。
用于收缩血管、提高血压和改善灌注的药物。

correct.en: This unfolding case teaches recognition and management of acute hemolytic transfusion reaction from ABO-incompatible red cells. The Stage 1 cue cluster—rapid fever/rigors, flank pain, hypotension, tachycardia, sense of impending doom, and hemoglobinuria—requires immediate transfusion cessation, safe maintenance of IV access with 0.9% normal saline through new tubing per protocol, notification of the provider and blood bank, and preservation of the unit/tubing/labels. Later stages show progression to shock, oliguric acute kidney injury, hyperkalemia, and DIC; outcomes must be evaluated by perfusion, urine output, potassium/creatinine, coagulation studies, and vasopressor needs rather than temperature alone.
correct.zh: 本病例训练识别和处理 ABO 不相容红细胞导致的急性溶血性输血反应。第1阶段的线索组合——快速发热寒战、腰痛、低血压、心动过速、濒危感和血红蛋白尿——要求立即停止输血，按流程用新管路和 0.9% 生理盐水安全维持 IV 通路，通知医护提供者和血库，并保留血袋/管路/标签。后续阶段进展为休克、少尿性急性肾损伤、高钾血症和 DIC；评价结果应看灌注、尿量、钾/肌酐、凝血指标和升压药需求，而不是单看体温。

testTakingStrategy.en: In transfusion questions, connect timing, symptom cluster, and first nursing action. Severe systemic findings mean stop the transfusion and escalate; do not slow the rate or treat only fever.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 输血题要把发生时间、症状组合和首要护理措施联系起来。严重全身表现意味着停止输血并升级处理；不要只是减慢速率或只退热。

glossary.defZh: 输注不相容血液后红细胞迅速破坏，可能导致休克、肾损伤和 DIC。
游离血红蛋白进入尿液，常呈红褐色。
与游离血红蛋白结合的血浆蛋白；血管内溶血时常降低。
凝血系统广泛激活并消耗血小板和凝血因子，可同时血栓和出血。
形成纤维蛋白凝块所需蛋白；在 DIC 中下降提示消耗。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Superior vena cava syndrome secondary to mediastinal malignancy
title.zh: 纵隔恶性肿瘤继发上腔静脉综合征

summary.en: A 58-year-old man with untreated non-small cell lung cancer and a known right mediastinal mass is admitted with two weeks of progressive facial swelling and dyspnea on exertion. The record unfolds from stable upper-body venous congestion to worsening respiratory distress with stridor, then partial response after emergency escalation.
summary.zh: 一名58岁男性患有尚未治疗的非小细胞肺癌，并已知存在右纵隔肿块，因两周进行性面部肿胀和活动后呼吸困难入院。病历从相对稳定的上半身静脉淤血，进展到伴喘鸣的呼吸窘迫加重，随后在紧急升级处理后出现部分改善。

content.en:
Background: 58-year-old man with a 40-pack-year smoking history and non-small cell lung cancer with a large right mediastinal mass. No history of DVT or heart failure. Orders include normal saline at 75 mL/hr, oxygen by nasal cannula to maintain SpO2 above 92%, head of bed at least 45 degrees, twice-daily weights, strict intake and output, and oncology consult. A right forearm peripheral IV is present.

Presentation and assessment: progressive facial puffiness for two weeks, worse in the morning; dyspnea on exertion; shirt collars feel tight; wedding ring still fits. Alert and oriented, speaking in full sentences, mild respiratory effort. Facial plethora and bilateral periorbital edema. Bilateral external jugular veins are distended and do not collapse with inspiration or with the head of bed at 45 degrees. Faint dilated superficial venous collaterals are present across the anterior chest wall. No lower-extremity edema. Hands and fingers are not edematous. Lung sounds are diminished in the right upper lobe with no wheezes, crackles, or stridor. Neurologic assessment is normal. Neck circumference at the cricoid cartilage is 44 cm.

Vital signs/labs: T 98.8 °F (37.1 °C), HR 92/min, BP 138/82 mmHg, RR 20/min, SpO2 94% on 2 L nasal cannula. WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL, Hgb 13.8 g/dL, platelets 268 ×10³/µL, Na 139 mEq/L, K 4.2 mEq/L, BUN 18 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, INR 1.0, PTT 28 seconds, D-dimer 0.8 µg/mL. ABG on 2 L nasal cannula: pH 7.42, PaCO2 36 mmHg, PaO2 72 mmHg, HCO3 23 mEq/L, SaO2 94%.
content.zh:
背景：58岁男性，有40包年吸烟史，患非小细胞肺癌，并有较大的右纵隔肿块。无DVT或心力衰竭病史。医嘱包括0.9%氯化钠75 mL/hr、鼻导管给氧维持SpO2高于92%、床头至少抬高45度、每日两次体重、严格出入量记录和肿瘤科会诊。右前臂有外周IV。

主诉与评估：面部发胀进行性加重两周，早晨更明显；活动后呼吸困难；衬衫领口感觉变紧；婚戒仍可佩戴。患者清醒定向，能说完整句子，有轻度呼吸费力。面部潮红，双侧眶周水肿。双侧颈外静脉扩张，吸气或床头抬高45度后仍不塌陷。前胸壁可见轻度扩张的浅表侧支静脉。无下肢水肿。双手和手指无水肿。右上肺呼吸音减弱，无哮鸣音、湿啰音或喘鸣。神经系统评估正常。环状软骨水平颈围44 cm。

生命体征/化验：T 98.8 °F (37.1 °C)，HR 92次/分，BP 138/82 mmHg，RR 20次/分，鼻导管2 L时SpO2 94%。WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL，Hgb 13.8 g/dL，血小板268 ×10³/µL，Na 139 mEq/L，K 4.2 mEq/L，BUN 18 mg/dL，肌酐0.9 mg/dL，INR 1.0，PTT 28秒，D-二聚体0.8 µg/mL。鼻导管2 L下ABG：pH 7.42，PaCO2 36 mmHg，PaO2 72 mmHg，HCO3 23 mEq/L，SaO2 94%。

content.en: The client remains at 45 degrees and rests comfortably. When the head of bed is inadvertently lowered to 20 degrees during a linen change, he immediately reports head fullness, his face reddens further, and SpO2 falls from 94% to 91% within 2 minutes. Restoring the head of bed to 45 degrees resolves the desaturation over 5 minutes. Hour 6 vital signs: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 94/min, BP 140/84 mmHg, RR 22/min, SpO2 94% at 45 degrees on 2 L nasal cannula. The right forearm IV has sluggish flow and mild swelling around the insertion site; it flushes and runs slowly. Urine output over 6 hours is 280 mL. Oncology has not yet examined the client.
content.zh: 患者保持床头45度并能舒适休息。更换床单时床头无意降至20度，患者立即诉头部胀满，面部进一步发红，SpO2在2分钟内从94%降至91%。恢复床头45度后，氧饱和度在5分钟内恢复。第6小时生命体征：T 99 °F (37.2 °C)，HR 94次/分，BP 140/84 mmHg，RR 22次/分，床头45度、鼻导管2 L时SpO2 94%。右前臂IV流速缓慢，穿刺点周围轻度肿胀；可冲管但运行缓慢。6小时尿量280 mL。肿瘤科尚未查视患者。

content.en: At hour 12, the client reports worsening shortness of breath while sitting upright. He speaks in short phrases and his voice is slightly hoarse. Facial and periorbital edema have increased; the neck appears more swollen. Neck circumference is 47 cm, up from 44 cm. Chest-wall venous collaterals are more prominent. Both upper extremities now have pitting edema to the mid-forearm. The right forearm IV has infiltrated and is discontinued. Vital signs: T 99.1 °F (37.3 °C), HR 110/min, BP 134/86 mmHg, RR 28/min, SpO2 90% on 2 L nasal cannula. Lung sounds are diminished in the right upper and middle lobes; faint inspiratory stridor is audible over the trachea with the bell. No wheezes or crackles. ABG on 2 L nasal cannula: pH 7.38, PaCO2 42 mmHg, PaO2 62 mmHg, HCO3 24 mEq/L, SaO2 90%. The admitting provider is available on the floor.
content.zh: 第12小时，患者坐高位时仍诉呼吸困难加重。只能短语交流，声音较入院时略嘶哑。面部和眶周水肿增加，颈部看起来更肿。颈围47 cm，高于基线44 cm。胸壁侧支静脉更加明显。双上肢现在有至前臂中部的凹陷性水肿。右前臂IV已渗出并停止使用。生命体征：T 99.1 °F (37.3 °C)，HR 110次/分，BP 134/86 mmHg，RR 28次/分，鼻导管2 L时SpO2 90%。右上肺和右中肺呼吸音减弱；用听诊器钟型胸件在气管上方可闻及轻微吸气性喘鸣。无哮鸣音或湿啰音。鼻导管2 L下ABG：pH 7.38，PaCO2 42 mmHg，PaO2 62 mmHg，HCO3 24 mEq/L，SaO2 90%。收治医护人员在病区可立即联系。

title.zh: 第3阶段升级处理后的反应

content.en: The nurse escalated to the provider, oxygen was increased to high-flow nasal cannula at 40 L/min with FiO2 0.50 per order, and the head of bed remains at 45 degrees. Oncology recommends urgent treatment; dexamethasone 4 mg IV every 6 hours is ordered and the first dose is administered. Interventional radiology is consulted for possible SVC stenting. At hour 24: SpO2 93% on high-flow nasal cannula, RR 24/min, HR 102/min, BP 130/80 mmHg. The client again speaks in short-to-moderate phrases. Stridor is no longer audible over the trachea. Neck circumference is 46 cm, down from 47 cm but still above the 44 cm baseline. Facial edema remains but is slightly less tense. Upper-extremity edema is unchanged. Urine output over the preceding 6 hours is 320 mL. The client feels a little better but is still short of breath with movement. A new peripheral IV has been placed in the left lower extremity after coordination with the team and per facility policy.
content.zh: 护士已向医护人员升级汇报；按医嘱氧疗升级为高流量鼻导管40 L/min、FiO2 0.50，床头保持45度。肿瘤科建议紧急治疗；医嘱地塞米松4 mg IV每6小时一次，并已给予首剂。介入放射科已会诊评估可能的SVC支架置入。第24小时：高流量鼻导管下SpO2 93%，RR 24次/分，HR 102次/分，BP 130/80 mmHg。患者可再次以短至中等长度短语交流。气管上方不再听到喘鸣。颈围46 cm，低于47 cm但仍高于44 cm基线。面部水肿仍在但紧绷感略减。上肢水肿无变化。过去6小时尿量320 mL。患者感觉“好一点”，但活动时仍气短。经团队协调并按照机构政策，已在左下肢置入新的外周IV且运行良好。

stem.en: Highlight the admission and Stage 1 findings that are significant cues of impaired venous return through the superior vena cava.
stem.zh: 请标出入院和第1阶段中提示上腔静脉静脉回流受阻的重要线索。

segments.en: Facial plethora
segments.zh: 面部潮红

segments.en: Bilateral periorbital edema
segments.zh: 双侧眶周水肿

segments.en: Bilateral external jugular veins that do not collapse with inspiration or 45-degree head elevation
segments.zh: 双侧颈外静脉扩张，吸气或床头抬高45度后仍不塌陷

segments.en: Faint dilated superficial venous collaterals across the anterior chest wall
segments.zh: 前胸壁可见轻度扩张的浅表侧支静脉

segments.en: Worse head fullness and desaturation when the head of bed is lowered
segments.zh: 床头降低时头部胀满感加重并出现氧饱和度下降

segments.en: Sluggish flow through a right forearm IV
segments.zh: 右前臂IV输液流速缓慢

segments.en: Diminished breath sounds in the right upper lobe with a known right mediastinal mass
segments.zh: 已知右纵隔肿块且右上肺呼吸音减弱

segments.en: No lower-extremity edema
segments.zh: 无下肢水肿

segments.en: Hands and fingers are non-edematous at admission
segments.zh: 入院时双手和手指无水肿

segments.en: Normal neurological findings and no headache
segments.zh: 神经系统检查正常且无头痛

segments.en: Temperature 98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
Capillary refill under 2 seconds bilaterally
segments.zh: 双侧毛细血管再充盈时间少于2秒

correct.en: The key pattern is congestion above the diaphragm: facial plethora, periorbital edema, non-collapsing jugular venous distention, chest-wall venous collaterals, position-dependent worsening, impaired upper-extremity IV flow, and findings consistent with the known mediastinal mass. Normal lower extremities and stable nonspecific findings do not rule out SVC obstruction.
correct.zh: 关键模式是横膈以上静脉淤血：面部潮红、眶周水肿、颈静脉扩张且不塌陷、胸壁侧支静脉、体位相关加重、上肢IV回流不畅，以及符合已知纵隔肿块的肺部发现。下肢正常和其他稳定的非特异表现不能排除上腔静脉受阻。

byChoice.en: Facial plethora is part of the upper-body venous congestion or position-dependent worsening expected with SVC obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 面部潮红属于上腔静脉受阻时可见的上半身静脉淤血或体位相关加重表现。

byChoice.en: Bilateral periorbital edema is part of the upper-body venous congestion or position-dependent worsening expected with SVC obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 双侧眶周水肿属于上腔静脉受阻时可见的上半身静脉淤血或体位相关加重表现。

byChoice.en: Bilateral external jugular veins that do not collapse with inspiration or 45-degree head elevation is part of the upper-body venous congestion or position-dependent worsening expected with SVC obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 双侧颈外静脉扩张，吸气或床头抬高45度后仍不塌陷属于上腔静脉受阻时可见的上半身静脉淤血或体位相关加重表现。

byChoice.en: Faint dilated superficial venous collaterals across the anterior chest wall is part of the upper-body venous congestion or position-dependent worsening expected with SVC obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 前胸壁可见轻度扩张的浅表侧支静脉属于上腔静脉受阻时可见的上半身静脉淤血或体位相关加重表现。

byChoice.en: Worse head fullness and desaturation when the head of bed is lowered is part of the upper-body venous congestion or position-dependent worsening expected with SVC obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 床头降低时头部胀满感加重并出现氧饱和度下降属于上腔静脉受阻时可见的上半身静脉淤血或体位相关加重表现。

byChoice.en: Sluggish flow through a right forearm IV is part of the upper-body venous congestion or position-dependent worsening expected with SVC obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 右前臂IV输液流速缓慢属于上腔静脉受阻时可见的上半身静脉淤血或体位相关加重表现。

byChoice.en: Diminished breath sounds in the right upper lobe with a known right mediastinal mass is part of the upper-body venous congestion or position-dependent worsening expected with SVC obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 已知右纵隔肿块且右上肺呼吸音减弱属于上腔静脉受阻时可见的上半身静脉淤血或体位相关加重表现。

byChoice.en: No lower-extremity edema is not a meaningful cue for SVC obstruction in this case; it either reflects a spared territory or a nonspecific stable finding.
byChoice.zh: 无下肢水肿在本病例中不是上腔静脉受阻的关键线索；它要么属于未受影响的部位，要么是非特异且稳定的发现。

byChoice.en: Hands and fingers are non-edematous at admission is not a meaningful cue for SVC obstruction in this case; it either reflects a spared territory or a nonspecific stable finding.
byChoice.zh: 入院时双手和手指无水肿在本病例中不是上腔静脉受阻的关键线索；它要么属于未受影响的部位，要么是非特异且稳定的发现。

byChoice.en: Normal neurological findings and no headache is not a meaningful cue for SVC obstruction in this case; it either reflects a spared territory or a nonspecific stable finding.
byChoice.zh: 神经系统检查正常且无头痛在本病例中不是上腔静脉受阻的关键线索；它要么属于未受影响的部位，要么是非特异且稳定的发现。

byChoice.en: Temperature 98.8 °F (37.1 °C) is not a meaningful cue for SVC obstruction in this case; it either reflects a spared territory or a nonspecific stable finding.
byChoice.zh: 体温98.8 °F (37.1 °C)在本病例中不是上腔静脉受阻的关键线索；它要么属于未受影响的部位，要么是非特异且稳定的发现。

byChoice.en: Capillary refill under 2 seconds bilaterally is not a meaningful cue for SVC obstruction in this case; it either reflects a spared territory or a nonspecific stable finding.
byChoice.zh: 双侧毛细血管再充盈时间少于2秒在本病例中不是上腔静脉受阻的关键线索；它要么属于未受影响的部位，要么是非特异且稳定的发现。

testTakingStrategy.en: For cue-recognition items, map each finding to anatomy. SVC obstruction should cluster in the face, neck, upper chest, and upper extremities, not the legs.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做线索识别题时，把每个发现对应到解剖位置。上腔静脉受阻的表现应集中在面部、颈部、上胸部和上肢，而不是下肢。

glossary.defZh: 面部因静脉淤血而发红或发紫的表现。
颈部静脉扩张，可提示静脉回流受阻或中心静脉压升高。
主要静脉通路受阻后出现的替代静脉回流通路。

stem.en: At Stage 1, which condition best explains the client’s cue cluster: upper-body venous congestion sparing the lower extremities, worsening when the head of bed is lowered, known right mediastinal mass, chest-wall venous collaterals, and a mildly elevated D-dimer?
stem.zh: 在第1阶段，哪种情况最能解释患者的线索组合：上半身静脉淤血但下肢未受累、床头降低时加重、已知右纵隔肿块、胸壁侧支静脉，以及D-二聚体轻度升高？

options.en: Community-acquired pneumonia causing hypoxemia
options.zh: 社区获得性肺炎导致低氧血症

options.en: Isolated upper-extremity deep vein thrombosis
options.zh: 孤立性上肢深静脉血栓

options.en: Superior vena cava syndrome from extrinsic compression by the mediastinal malignancy
options.zh: 纵隔恶性肿瘤外压导致的上腔静脉综合征

options.en: Acute decompensated heart failure with volume overload
options.zh: 容量负荷过重导致的急性失代偿性心力衰竭

correct.en: The bilateral face, neck, upper chest, and upper-extremity pattern with collateral veins localizes the problem to the SVC. The known mediastinal mass supplies the mechanism. The mildly elevated D-dimer is nonspecific in malignancy and does not outweigh the anatomic pattern.
correct.zh: 双侧面部、颈部、上胸部和上肢受累，并伴有侧支静脉，提示问题定位在上腔静脉。已知纵隔肿块提供了机制。恶性肿瘤患者D-二聚体轻度升高并不特异，不能推翻这个解剖学模式。

byChoice.en: This matches the distribution, position-dependent worsening, venous collaterals, and known mediastinal mass.
byChoice.zh: 这符合受累分布、体位相关加重、侧支静脉以及已知纵隔肿块。

byChoice.en: An isolated upper-extremity DVT would not explain bilateral facial edema, bilateral JVD, and chest-wall collaterals in this pattern.
byChoice.zh: 孤立性上肢DVT不能解释这种模式下的双侧面部水肿、双侧颈静脉怒张和胸壁侧支静脉。

byChoice.en: Heart failure would more typically include pulmonary crackles, lower-extremity edema, and generalized volume overload rather than isolated upper-body venous congestion.
byChoice.zh: 心力衰竭通常更可能出现肺部湿啰音、下肢水肿和全身容量负荷过重，而不是孤立的上半身静脉淤血。

byChoice.en: Pneumonia could cause respiratory symptoms, but it does not explain the upper-body venous congestion and positional worsening.
byChoice.zh: 肺炎可导致呼吸症状，但不能解释上半身静脉淤血和体位相关加重。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not anchor on one abnormal lab. First decide whether the full cue pattern localizes to a body system or an anatomic obstruction.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要被一个异常化验值锚定。先判断全部线索是否能定位到某个系统或解剖性阻塞。

glossary.defZh: 纤维蛋白降解产物，升高提示凝血/纤溶活动增加，但在恶性肿瘤等情况下可不特异升高。
血管或气道被外部结构如肿瘤压迫而变窄。
位于胸腔中央纵隔区域的占位，可压迫大血管或气道。

stem.en: At Stage 2, which new or worsening finding is the most immediately life-threatening?
stem.zh: 在第2阶段，哪个新出现或加重的发现最具有立即生命威胁？

options.en: Heart rate increased to 110/min
options.zh: 心率升至110次/分

options.en: New faint inspiratory stridor over the trachea
options.zh: 气管上方新出现的轻微吸气性喘鸣

options.en: Neck circumference increased from 44 cm to 47 cm
options.zh: 颈围从44 cm增加到47 cm

options.en: SpO2 decreased to 90% on 2 L nasal cannula
options.zh: 使用2 L鼻导管时SpO2降至90%

correct.en: New inspiratory stridor is the priority because it indicates narrowing of the upper airway. In SVC syndrome, worsening venous congestion can cause airway edema or compression that may progress rapidly to complete obstruction.
correct.zh: 新出现的吸气性喘鸣最优先，因为它提示上气道变窄。在上腔静脉综合征中，静脉淤血加重可导致气道水肿或受压，并可能迅速进展为完全性阻塞。

byChoice.en: The increasing neck circumference confirms worsening congestion, but stridor shows that the process has reached the airway.
byChoice.zh: 颈围增加证实淤血加重，但喘鸣说明病变已经影响气道。

byChoice.en: Tachycardia is concerning but is a compensatory response, not the sentinel sign of impending airway obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 心动过速令人担忧，但它是代偿反应，不是即将发生气道阻塞的哨兵征象。

byChoice.en: Stridor directly signals airway narrowing, making this an airway emergency.
byChoice.zh: 喘鸣直接提示气道变窄，因此这是气道急症。

byChoice.en: The oxygen saturation is abnormal, but the airway sign that explains the most lethal trajectory is the new stridor.
byChoice.zh: 氧饱和度异常，但最能提示致命进展的是新出现的喘鸣。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several findings are abnormal, apply ABCs tightly. A sign of airway narrowing outranks other respiratory or compensatory findings.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个发现异常时，要严格应用ABC原则。气道变窄的体征优先于其他呼吸或代偿性表现。

glossary.defZh: 高调、常在吸气时出现的呼吸音，提示上气道狭窄。
气道通畅性下降，可能影响通气或氧合的状态。
提示严重恶化风险的早期关键表现。

stem.en: At Stage 2, which actions should the nurse take first as part of the emergency response? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在第2阶段，护士应首先采取哪些措施作为紧急反应的一部分？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Lower the head of bed to facilitate a full chest assessment.
options.zh: 降低床头以便完成全面胸部评估。

options.en: Confirm the head of bed remains at 45 degrees or higher.
options.zh: 确认床头保持45度或更高。

options.en: Activate rapid response or the facility emergency escalation process and notify the provider of new stridor.
options.zh: 启动快速反应或机构紧急升级流程，并通知医护人员新出现喘鸣。

options.en: Increase oxygen delivery using available respiratory distress equipment or protocol.
options.zh: 根据可用设备或呼吸窘迫流程提高氧气输送。

options.en: Bring emergency airway equipment, suction, bag-valve-mask, and oxygen escalation supplies to the bedside.
options.zh: 将紧急气道设备、吸引装置、简易呼吸器和升级氧疗用品准备到床旁。

options.en: Attempt a new left forearm IV before calling for help.
options.zh: 在呼叫支援前先尝试置入新的左前臂IV。

correct.en: The client has new stridor with worsening hypoxemia and upper-body edema, so immediate nursing priorities are oxygenation, upright positioning, emergency escalation/provider notification, and readiness for airway deterioration. Vascular access is important after the airway response is underway, but an upper-extremity attempt before calling help delays the priority response and is likely to fail.
correct.zh: 患者出现新发喘鸣，并伴低氧和上半身水肿加重，因此护士的立即优先事项是改善氧合、保持坐高位、启动紧急升级/通知医护人员，并准备应对气道恶化。建立血管通路很重要，但应在气道处理启动后进行；在呼叫支援前先尝试上肢IV会延误优先处理且可能失败。

byChoice.en: Lowering the head of bed worsens venous congestion and previously caused desaturation in this client.
byChoice.zh: 降低床头会加重静脉淤血，而且该患者先前已因此发生氧饱和度下降。

byChoice.en: Increasing oxygen delivery supports oxygenation while help and definitive interventions are mobilized.
byChoice.zh: 提高氧气输送可在调动支援和根本性处理前支持氧合。

byChoice.en: New stridor is an airway warning sign that requires rapid response or emergency escalation and prompt provider notification.
byChoice.zh: 新发喘鸣是气道警讯，需要启动快速反应或紧急升级，并及时通知医护人员。

byChoice.en: Airway equipment should be ready because partial obstruction can deteriorate quickly.
byChoice.zh: 应准备好气道设备，因为部分气道阻塞可能迅速恶化。

byChoice.en: A left forearm IV is still upper-extremity access and should not delay emergency airway and breathing actions.
byChoice.zh: 左前臂IV仍属于上肢通路，不应延误气道和呼吸的紧急处理。

byChoice.en: Upright positioning helps reduce venous congestion above the obstruction and avoids the known position-dependent worsening.
byChoice.zh: 坐高位有助于减轻阻塞上方的静脉淤血，并避免已知的体位相关恶化。

testTakingStrategy.en: In SATA emergency-response items, key actions that address the immediate threat and escalation. Exclude tasks that delay ABCs or worsen the physiology.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做多选紧急处理题时，选择能处理立即威胁并升级求援的措施。排除会延误ABC或加重病理生理的任务。

glossary.defZh: 在患者病情急性恶化时被呼叫的跨专业紧急支援团队。
用于辅助通气的手动通气装置。
床头高抬的体位，可改善呼吸并减少上半身静脉淤血。

stem.en: After the infiltrated right forearm IV is discontinued and the airway response is underway, where should the nurse obtain replacement peripheral IV access?
stem.zh: 在停止已渗出的右前臂IV且气道处理已启动后，护士应在哪里获得替代外周静脉通路？

options.en: Coordinate non–upper-extremity peripheral access per facility policy and provider direction.
options.zh: 按机构政策和医嘱协调非上肢外周静脉通路。

options.en: Place a new right antecubital IV because it is closer to central circulation.
options.zh: 在右肘窝重新置入IV，因为它更接近中心循环。

options.en: Request an upper-extremity PICC line as the fastest reliable access.
options.zh: 申请上肢PICC作为最快且可靠的通路。

options.en: Place a peripheral IV in the left hand because the right forearm IV failed.
options.zh: 因右前臂IV失败，在左手置入外周IV。

correct.en: Upper-extremity venous return drains through the obstructed SVC, so either arm can have high back-pressure, unreliable flow, and infiltration risk. Non–upper-extremity access, such as lower-extremity access when allowed by policy and ordered/arranged by the team, drains through the IVC and is more appropriate for this anatomy.
correct.zh: 上肢静脉回流需要经过受阻的上腔静脉，因此任一手臂都可能出现高回压、输液不可靠和渗出风险。非上肢通路（如政策允许并由团队医嘱/协调的下肢通路）经下腔静脉回流，更符合本病例的解剖情况。

byChoice.en: This applies the anatomy of SVC obstruction and defers the exact site to policy and team direction.
byChoice.zh: 这体现了对上腔静脉受阻解剖的应用，并将具体部位交由政策和团队指示决定。

byChoice.en: An upper-extremity PICC also uses the obstructed upper-body venous drainage and is not the fastest reliable solution in acute SVC obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 上肢PICC同样依赖受阻的上半身静脉回流，在急性上腔静脉受阻时不是最快且可靠的解决方案。

byChoice.en: A right antecubital site is still proximal to the same obstructed venous pathway and does not solve the back-pressure problem.
byChoice.zh: 右肘窝仍位于同一受阻静脉通路的近端，不能解决回压问题。

byChoice.en: The left hand still drains through the upper-extremity venous system into the SVC, so it may fail like the right forearm site.
byChoice.zh: 左手仍通过上肢静脉系统回流至上腔静脉，因此可能像右前臂通路一样失败。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a vascular-access question is tied to an obstruction, trace the venous drainage route rather than choosing the opposite limb automatically.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当血管通路题与阻塞有关时，要追踪静脉回流路径，而不是自动选择对侧肢体。

glossary.defZh: 输液从静脉漏入周围组织。
将下半身静脉血回流至心脏的大静脉。

glossary.termZh: 经外周置入中心静脉导管
glossary.defZh: 通常从上肢外周静脉置入并进入中心静脉的导管。

stem.en: At Stage 3, classify each finding when evaluating the response to treatment.
stem.zh: 在第3阶段，评估治疗反应时请对每个发现进行分类。

rows.en: Stridor is no longer audible over the trachea.
rows.zh: 气管上方不再听到喘鸣。

rows.en: SpO2 is 93%, but only on high-flow nasal cannula at 40 L/min and FiO2 0.50.
rows.zh: SpO2为93%，但需要高流量鼻导管40 L/min、FiO2 0.50。

rows.en: Neck circumference is 46 cm, down from 47 cm but still above the 44 cm baseline.
rows.zh: 颈围为46 cm，低于47 cm但仍高于44 cm基线。

rows.en: The client still becomes short of breath with movement.
rows.zh: 患者活动时仍感呼吸困难。

rows.en: Urine output is 320 mL over the preceding 6 hours.
rows.zh: 过去6小时尿量为320 mL。

columns.zh: 提示仍有风险/尚未解决

correct.en: The absent stridor is the strongest early improvement because it suggests less airway narrowing. However, the client still requires much higher oxygen support, has persistent neck edema above baseline, and remains dyspneic with movement, so the obstruction is not resolved. Urine output is useful for general perfusion but does not track the primary SVC threat.
correct.zh: 喘鸣消失是最重要的早期改善信号，因为它提示气道狭窄减轻。但患者仍需要明显更高的氧疗支持，颈部水肿仍高于基线，活动时仍气短，因此阻塞尚未解决。尿量可反映总体灌注，但不是追踪SVC主要威胁的指标。

byChoice.en: Resolution of stridor suggests the airway narrowing is easing, so this supports early improvement.
byChoice.zh: 喘鸣消失提示气道狭窄缓解，因此支持早期改善。

byChoice.en: A similar saturation achieved only with high-flow oxygen shows ongoing respiratory compromise, not full stabilization.
byChoice.zh: 只有在高流量氧疗下才达到类似氧饱和度，说明呼吸受损仍存在，并非完全稳定。

byChoice.en: A neck circumference still above baseline means upper-body venous congestion persists.
byChoice.zh: 颈围仍高于基线，说明上半身静脉淤血仍然存在。

byChoice.en: Dyspnea with movement shows limited reserve and continued risk for re-deterioration.
byChoice.zh: 活动时气短说明储备有限，仍有再次恶化风险。

byChoice.en: Urine output is acceptable but is not the main marker of airway patency, oxygen requirement, or upper-body edema in SVC syndrome.
byChoice.zh: 尿量尚可，但不是评估SVC综合征气道通畅、氧疗需求或上半身水肿的主要指标。

testTakingStrategy.en: Compare oxygenation in context. A higher saturation on much more support can still mean the client remains unstable.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估氧合时必须结合支持强度。若在更高支持下才有较高氧饱和度，患者仍可能不稳定。

glossary.defZh: 吸入气体中氧气的比例。
用于趋势评估颈部肿胀程度的客观测量。
比较干预前后关键指标以判断病情是否改善、稳定或恶化。

correct.en: This case tests recognition and management of malignant SVC syndrome. The key cue cluster is upper-body venous congestion with facial plethora, periorbital edema, non-collapsing JVD, chest-wall venous collaterals, and position-dependent worsening in a client with a known mediastinal mass. Stage 2 becomes an airway emergency when stridor appears with worsening hypoxemia and neck edema. The nurse should optimize oxygenation, maintain upright positioning, escalate immediately, prepare airway equipment, and avoid unreliable upper-extremity IV access. Improvement is judged by airway patency, oxygen requirement in context, respiratory effort, and upper-body edema trends; a single improved saturation on much higher oxygen support is not enough to declare the client stable.
correct.zh: 本病例考查恶性肿瘤相关上腔静脉综合征的识别和处理。关键线索是已知纵隔肿块患者出现上半身静脉淤血，包括面部潮红、眶周水肿、颈静脉扩张且不塌陷、胸壁侧支静脉和体位相关加重。第2阶段出现喘鸣并伴低氧和颈部水肿加重时，情况转为气道急症。护士应改善氧合、保持坐高位、立即升级汇报、准备气道设备，并避免不可靠的上肢IV通路。评估改善应关注气道通畅、氧疗需求的背景、呼吸功和上半身水肿趋势；在更高氧疗支持下单一氧饱和度改善不足以说明患者已经稳定。

testTakingStrategy.en: Follow the unfolding trend. First localize the edema anatomically, then reprioritize immediately when a new airway sign appears.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 跟随病情展开趋势。先从解剖上定位水肿分布；一旦出现新的气道体征，立即重新排序优先级。

glossary.defZh: 上腔静脉回流受阻导致头、颈、上肢和上胸部静脉淤血的一组表现。
气流通过狭窄上气道时产生的高调呼吸音，提示可能有气道受压或阻塞。
因主要静脉通路受阻而形成或显现的替代回流通路。
提供较高流量和设定氧浓度的氧疗方式，用于改善氧合但不能替代气道评估。
